show.title: Panchayat
show.synopsis: An engineering graduate, Abhishek Tripathi, unable to find a corporate job matching his aspirations, reluctantly takes up the low-paying job of Panchayat Secretary (Sachiv) in the remote, eccentric village of Phulera, Uttar Pradesh. While preparing for the CAT exam to escape, he gets entangled in the quaint daily politics, quirks, and touching lives of the villagers.

recaps.storyRecap: Abhishek struggles through power outages, monitor theft, solar light disputes, and the dreaded ergonomic revolving chair fiasco. Preparing for his CAT exam under candlelight, he gives it his all but doesn't score enough. Dejected, he climbs Phulera's iconic water tank to clear his head, where he unexpectedly meets Pradhan ji's daughter, Rinky. Meanwhile, Manju Devi proudly learns and sings the National Anthem for Republic Day.

recaps.storyRecap: A heartbreaking masterpiece of an episode. MLA Chandrakishore Singh disrespects Abhishek and Pradhan ji over village road construction, demanding Abhishek grovel. Pradhan ji stands up for Abhishek's dignity. But political tensions vanish in an instant when tragedy strikes: Prahlad's beloved son Rahul is martyred on the front lines. The entire village rallies in silence to support a devastated Prahlad, as Abhishek holds back tears.

recaps.storyRecap: The gloves come off in Phulera! Vengeful Vidhayak Chandrakishore arranges Abhishek's punitive transfer, but the villagers protest fiercely to bring Sachiv ji back. Bhushan (Banrakas) fields his wife Kranti Devi for the upcoming Sarpanch election. The brewing animosity erupts at the Phulera bus stop into an epic, hilarious, full-blown rural brawl between Pradhan's crew and the Vidhayak's goons, leaving Pradhan ji hospitalized and Abhishek ready to fight for his village.
